description: Add a JSON job using the write token and a stable job_key. The same key and payload return the original job. Changing the payload for that key is a conflict. Payloads are limited to 16 KiB encoded JSON and must contain no secrets or personal data. The 100-job lifetime limit includes completed and failed jobs.

job_key.description: Your own stable key for the job, 1 to 64 characters. A repeat with the same key and payload returns the original job.

payload.description: Required JSON value, including null. Maximum encoded size: 16384 bytes.

queue_id.description: The queue_id from create_agent_queue, or from create_agent_run for a run with delegated steps.

write_token.description: The write_token from create_agent_queue, shown once. It adds jobs.

name: enqueue_agent_queue_job
title: Enqueue agent queue job
